1.text: Zaburi iyi ni iya Dawidi, ubwo yisarishirizaga imbere ya Abimeleki, akamwirukana akagenda.

2.text: Nzahimbaza Uwiteka iminsi yose,Ishimwe rye rizaba mu kanwa kanjye iteka.

3.text: Uwiteka ni we umutima wanjye uzirata,Abanyamubabaro babyumve bishime.

4.text: Mufatanye nanjye guhimbaza Uwiteka,Dushyirane hejuru izina rye.

5.text: Nashatse Uwiteka aransubiza,Ankiza ubwoba nari mfite bwose.

6.text: Bamurebyeho bavirwa n'umucyo,Mu maso habo ntihazagira ipfunwe iteka.

7.text: Uyu munyamubabaro yaratatse, Uwiteka aramwumva,Amukiza amakuba n'ibyago bye byose.

8.text: Marayika w'Uwiteka abambisha amahema yo kugota abamwubaha,Akabakiza.

9.text: Nimusogongere mumenye yuko Uwiteka agira neza,Hahirwa umuhungiraho.

10.text: Mwubahe Uwiteka mwa bera be mwe,Kuko abamwubaha batagira icyo bakena.

11.text: Imigunzu y'intare ibasha gukena no gusonza,Ariko abashaka Uwiteka ntibazagira icyiza bakena.

12.text: Bana bato nimuze munyumve,Ndabigisha kūbaha Uwiteka.

13.text: Ni nde ushaka ubugingo,Agakunda kurama kugira ngo azabone ibyiza?

14.text: Ujye ubuza ururimi rwawe rutavuga ikibi,N'iminwa yawe itavuga iby'uburiganya.

15.text: Va mu byaha ujye ukora ibyiza,Ujye ushaka amahoro uyakurikire,Kugira ngo uyashyikire.

16.text: Amaso y'Uwiteka ari ku bakiranutsi,N'amatwi ye ari ku gutaka kwabo.

17.text: Igitsure cy'Uwiteka kiri ku bakora ibyaha,Kugira ngo amareho kwibukwa kwabo mu isi.

18.text: Abakiranutsi baratatse Uwiteka arabumva,Abakiza amakuba n'ibyago byabo byose.

19.text: Uwiteka aba hafi y'abafite imitima imenetse.Kandi akiza abafite imitima ishenjaguwe.

20.text: Amakuba n'ibyago by'umukiranutsi ni byinshi,Ariko Uwiteka amukiza muri byose.

21.text: Arinda amagufwa ye yose,Nta na rimwe rivunika.

22.text: Ibyaha bizicisha umunyabyaha,Abanga umukiranutsi bazacirwaho iteka.

23.text: Uwiteka acungura ubugingo bw'abagaragu be,Nta wo mu bamuhungiraho uzacirwaho iteka.
